shot: one shot, camera locked, vertical 9:16, bold and simple, very few shapes. dead centre: a wide open doorway drawn as a thick deep green #1e4034 inverted U, with the pale paper background #f1f2ee clearly visible through the opening so it reads as a way through. standing in the opening, filling half the frame height: one figure with a tiny round head, no face, no eyes, a blocky deep green torso and long thin noodle limbs with rounded bends. the figure holds one oversized solid mid green #2c5f4d rounded rectangle out in front at waist height in both huge hands, well below the head so the tiny head is fully visible and unobstructed against the pale opening. the rectangle is a strong solid green block, clearly darker than the background, with clean empty paper all around it. to the right of the doorway stands one narrow pale grey #cdd0c8 post with a single slim dark vertical slot in it. exactly one background shape and no more: one large pale #e6e8e2 circle centred behind the doorway. no bars, no stripes, nothing crossing the figure. the top third and the bottom quarter of the frame are completely empty flat paper colour with nothing in them. the motion is one closed cycle and nothing else: the figure raises the green rectangle from waist height up towards the slot in the post, holds it there a beat, then lowers it back down to waist height, finishing in exactly the pose it started in. the figure never walks, never leaves the doorway, and never exits the frame. the doorway, the post, and the circle do not move at all.
audio: sound design only. a soft paper thump when the rectangle posts into the slot, two light wooden footsteps, one low hollow knock as the rectangle rises back. no voice, no speech, no music, no melody.

captions.line:
it is a bond, not a fee.
leave on time and get
*every dollar back*.

*one late day*
and it is gone
